prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent illustrated pet-bed game sprite, rendered small on a hand-painted interior website.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact shape, perspective, padding and registration guide. Image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY for the painted room, its material finish and light. Do not reproduce the room.
Primary request: upgrade this single empty warm-ivory donut dog bed so it belongs naturally in the same richly hand-painted 2.5D room as image 2. Replace the photographic long stringy fur with premium short, soft plush and tactile brushed textile described by restrained visible gouache/oil brush clusters, coherent broad shaded planes and softly broken painted edges. Make it feel luxurious, warm and touchable, but clearly hand-painted rather than a product photograph or a 3D render. Subtle sewn piping around the lower outside bolster and a delicately stitched inset cushion seam are welcome. No heavy outline.
Shape invariants: retain the current exact low, wide elliptical donut silhouette and low frontal three-quarter camera angle. Same thick back/side bolsters, same generous oval recessed cushion, same low front bolster, same object placement in the image. The whole sprite canvas is approximately 1.83:1 wide. Keep the full bed inside the frame with the original padding: bed starts at about 7% height and ends at 95% height; width fills about 97%. Interior cushion center is 50% image width and 49% image height. Inner edge of the front rim at horizontal center must remain at about 67% image height; preserve its smooth curved path to about 51% height at 14% and 86% width. This precise shape lets an existing sleeping dog and foreground rim layer align later. Do not add a dog now.
Materials/color: muted warm ivory and oatmeal/greige, subtle stone taupe creases, soft cream highlights. Refined short plush with larger purposeful brush marks and delicate textile weave, not long individual strands. Restrained saturation, no yellow/orange cast. Existing bed proportions remain identical.
Lighting: gentle upper-left neutral daylight, modest warm room bounce, soft painted self-shadow inside the bed, no glossy hotspot. A very thin neutral translucent contact shadow may sit directly beneath the lower edge but must fit within the existing bottom padding; no broad halo or floor plane.
Background: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha outside the bed, perfectly clear empty corners, no colored matte, no checkerboard texture. The bed itself must be opaque. Clean natural painted edges with a short antialiased alpha transition.
Avoid: photorealism, wispy long hairs, hard cartoon outlines, smooth plastic/3D shading, beige glowing aura, scattered flecks outside the bed, floor, room, furniture, animal, ball, extra object, text, logo, watermark. Output only the empty bed sprite.

references.role: Edit target; original silhouette and registration

conversion.method: Pillow Lanczos RGBA proportional downscale to 520x284; WebP quality93 method6; atomic os.replace
conversion.creativeEdits: Only built-in ImageGen; no manual painting, alpha keying or warping

registration.css: Unchanged .ph-bed and .ph-bed-front polygon, including existing static contact shadow

validation.rootVisualApproval: Approved after before/after full-room and close-up inspection
validation.qaMethod: Read-only image composites using native plate, existing sleep asset at registered (898,915) support anchor→(1440,865), .847 art scale and current depth factor, current frontlip polygon; night bed brightness .69/saturation .8. CSS contact shadow approximated analytically. These are art QA, not browser screenshots.
validation.observations: Short painted plush and subtle piping fit the room; the empty and occupied bed has no hard matte, no duplicate baked shadow and no pet cut-through. All four alpha corners are zero. A few exterior pixels carry alpha1/255 but alpha>=8 follows the silhouette cleanly and no visible flecks occur in the composite. No CSS geometry or Milky assets changed.
